method: A 1 m success requires an explicit recorded STOP and final distance_to_goal < 1.0 m. Path efficiency is preserved from SPL for existing 0.1 m successes; for newly admitted 1 m successes it is reconstructed from the episode geodesic distance and Habitat soft-SPL identity.
validation: The reconstruction was checked against all 1000 stored OF-base strict successes and all 1086 OF-ApexTarget stored 1 m successes; maximum absolute SPL discrepancy was 2.39e-4 and 6.84e-5 respectively.
